postconditions.description: The root of the BST is not None.

postconditions.expression: all(root.val + sum(node.val for node in traverse_greater(root, root.val)) == modified_node.val for modified_node in traverse_inorder(root))
postconditions.description: Each node's value in the modified BST is the sum of its original value and the values of all nodes greater than it in the original BST. The traversal_inorder function returns all nodes in the BST in ascending order of their values.
